name: Isiququmadevu
body:
ISIQUQUMADEVU
CR 25

A titanic mass of living earth, mud, and rock squats on powerful froglike legs. Its bloated bulk is swathed in moss, roots, and tangled vines. Swaying hairlike tendrils dangle beneath an enormous fanged maw.

XP 1,638,400
N Colossal outsider (earth, elemental, native)
Init +7; Senses blindsight 90 ft., darkvision 600 ft.; Perception +36

DEFENSE

AC 43, touch 6, flat-footed 39 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +37 natural, –8 size)
hp 560 (32d10+384); fast healing 30
Fort +24, Ref +23, Will +21
Defensive Abilities recovery; DR 20/epic; Immune ability damage, ability drain, acid, death effects, disease, elemental traits (immune to bleed, critical hits, flanking, paralysis, poison, sleep, sneak attacks, and stunning), energy drain, fear, petrification, polymorph; Resist cold 30, electricity 30, fire 30, negative energy 30, sonic 30; SR 36

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., swim 80 ft.
Special Attacks critical ascendancy, fast swallow, seismic leap, snapping maw, storm of beetles, swallow whole (5d6+16 plus 5d6 acid damage, AC 28, 56 hp), trample (3d8+16, DC 37)
Melee 2 bite +35 (6d6+22/19–20 plus grab), 2 slams +35 (3d8+11/19–20)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 32, Dex 16, Con 35, Int 7, Wis 12, Cha 11
Base Atk +32; CMB +51; CMD 65
Feats Combat Reflexes, Critical Focus, Critical Mastery, Dodge, Exhausting Critical, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (bite, slam), Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (bite, slam), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Staggering Critical, Stunning Critical, Tiring Critical
Skills Acrobatics +35 (+55 when jumping), Perception +36, Stealth +22 (+30 in rocky or swampy terrain), Swim +51; Racial Modifiers +12 Acrobatics when jumping, +8 Stealth in rocky or swampy terrain
Languages Common
SQ powerful leaper, ruinous bite

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Critical Ascendancy (Ex)

An isiququmadevu can take the Critical Mastery feat without meeting the feat’s prerequisites. An isiququmadevu usually applies the effects of both Exhausting Critical and Stunning Critical when confirming a critical hit.

Fast Swallow (Ex)

An isiququmadevu can use swallow whole as a free action at any time during its turn, not just at the start of its turn.

Powerful Leaper (Ex)

An isiququmadevu uses its Strength to modify Acrobatics checks made to jump.

Ruinous Bite (Ex)

An isiququmadevu applies twice its Strength modifier to bite damage. Its bite attack ignores hardness less than 20.

Recovery (Ex)

Whenever an isiququmadevu fails a saving throw against any mind-affecting or immobilizing effect (including binding and temporal stasis, but not imprisonment), it can attempt a new saving throw at the start of its turn each round until it succeeds.

Seismic Leap (Ex)

As a standard action, an isiququmadevu leaps up to 80 feet and this movement doesn’t provoke an attack of opportunity. When it lands, all Gargantuan or smaller creatures whose space it lands in are subject to its trample attack. These creatures can attempt Reflex saves or attacks of opportunity as normal. All creatures damaged by this trample are automatically knocked prone. Additionally, all Huge or smaller creatures standing on the ground who are within 60 feet of the landing point must succeed at a DC 37 Reflex save or be knocked prone.

The save DC is Strength-based.

Snapping Maw (Ex)

An isiququmadevu’s maw snaps shut faster than the eye can follow. It can make two bite attacks as part of a full attack.

Storm of Beetles (Su)

As a standard action, an isiququmadevu calls forth and then spits a cloud of flesh-burrowing beetles at a point within 150 feet. These beetles have the statistics of a rot grub swarmb4, with a 30-foot fly speed (Fly +10). The swarm acts immediately, but isiququmadevu has no control over it.

Isiququmadevu can use this ability 9 times per day.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm mountains
Organization solitary
Treasure double

An isiququmadevu (also isikukumadevu) is a titanic entity with a maw vast enough to swallow a village. It is known by many titles including the Mother of Beetles and the Feller of Lofty Thorn-trees. Its form blends froglike limbs, a hunchbacked frame, and featherlike pinions that sprout from its back, all sculpted from earth, mud, and greenery. The isiququmadevu is grotesque but also somehow strangely majestic.

Isiququmadevu dwells in hilly and mountainous regions, often lurking near rivers or even swamplands, where its earthen mass merges with the surrounding terrain. Despite its great size, an isiququmadevu has an avaricious streak and loves to steal jewelry, fine clothing, and shiny objects. It is said those fortunate enough to defeat an isiququmadevu may discover a hidden hoard inside the creature’s cavernous maw, consisting of elegant garments, suits of armor, and exotic trinkets. Many tales speak of isiququmadevu swallowing entire armies, yet in some stories it is driven off by a single determined hero.
